notes.title: Update 2024.01.19

Update 2024.01.19
Update Content 
Added the room system with the following categories: bedroom, greenhouse, kitchen, boiler room, and water room. Categories can be stacked. The greenhouse provides an accelerated plant growth effect, while the bedroom accelerates stamina recovery.

notes.notes:
Update Details:
1.Added a Shower with adjustable water control.
2.Introduced a lamp utilizing steam for illumination.
3.Redesigned the heat transfer mechanism.

notes.title: Update 2023.12.29
notes.notes:
Update Details:
1.Added an item called [FarmlandMark], which can designate land as arable. NPCs will plant crops of your choice in these marked areas.

2.Modified the effects of [SpeechNote] and [MedicalKit].
[SpeechNote] grants NPCs a 10-minute [Inspiration] effect, enhancing their movement speed and productivity.
[MedicalKit] gives NPCs a 10-minute [Healing] effect, gradually restoring their health.

3.Introduced a new lighting mode called [Penetrate], where solid blocks no longer completely obstruct light.

4.Enhanced NPC behavior; they will now coordinate and allocate their respective tasks.
[previewyoutube=u_ssA50QRn4;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update 2023.12.15
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=5NUaKMN0Z54;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
2023.12.15
Update Content

1.Improved tutorials. Tutorials are now presented in video format.
2.Added a pressure valve pipeline. Gas is allowed to pass only when the pressure exceeds the set value.
3.The pressure gauge now displays the air pressure value at the cursor position.
4.NPCs will now learn to use power tracks.

notes.title: Update 2023.12.12
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=FqqUh_-x3Mo;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

2023.12.12

New Additions 
1.Bathtub: Works under conditions of sufficient water supply and an ambient temperature > 40 degrees Celsius. NPCs bathing in it will gradually increase their emotional state.
2.Chopped Tree Stump: Used to produce some wooden raw materials. NPCs with the manufacturing task option enabled will work here.
3.Anvil: Used to produce some metal-based raw materials. NPCs with the manufacturing task option enabled will work here.
4.Insulating Bricks: Possess excellent insulation properties.

Bug Fixes
1.Previous issues with NPC construction skills causing leaks in the pipes have been rectified.
2.Fix implemented for the problem where disabling the beginner's guide might cause the main storyline to get stuck.
